	name = "Lalibela"
	dynasty = 101793

	culture = agaw

	trait = diligent
	trait = generous
	trait = education_stewardship_3
	1155.1.1 = {
		birth = yes
		effect = { add_character_flag = do_not_generate_starting_family }
	}
	1221.1.1 = {
		add_trait = saint
		death = yes
		effect_even_if_dead = {
			pam_canonize_saint_effect = {
				CANONIZER = root
				CANDIDATE = root
				CONSECRATION_PROVINCE = province:8301 # Lalibela, the rock-hewn churches of Roha, his tomb in Golgotha
				PRESET = yes
			}
			religion:christianity_religion = {
				every_faith = {
					limit = {
						MB_alexandrian_saint_faith_trigger = yes
						main_rite = { is_rite_enabled = yes }
						NOT = { has_saint_character = root }
					}
					add_saint = { character = root }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	1178.6.1 = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_alive = yes is_landed = no NOT = { exists = employer } }
				set_landless_government_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
